Nora (mktg ops): Heads up — prepping Friday KPI slate. Noticed an oddity in the inbound routing table where webinar leads spike but MQL rate drops for certain UTM_campaigns.
Diego R.: Which campaigns? I can check the leadflow dashboard.
Nora (mktg ops): UTM_campaigns: 'webinar_march_launch' and 'launch-rebroadcast'. The funnel looks like: register -> visit pricing -> drop before demo request.
Priya K.: Could be auto-tagging mismatch between marketing forms and sales queue. We saw a mapping issue last quarter.
Ari (growth): I pulled cohort breakdown: webinar_march_launch cohort has 18% conversion to MQL vs baseline 26%. The demo request CTA CTR is 12% vs 19% baseline.
Nora (mktg ops): Ops-bot: "ops-bot: data-pipeline status OK. Last ETL: 2026-03-19-18:00Z."
Diego R.: I compared HubSpot vs internal SFDC ingest; HubSpot shows more demo requests but SFDC webhook stutters around 3/12 14:00Z.
Priya K.: If SFDC lost webhook events, the dashboard metric (which relies on SFDC) would undercount conversions. We should surface both systems for KPI review.
Ari (growth): Agreed. Also see elevated bounce on pricing page for users from the webinar email cohort — copy mismatch again?
Nora (mktg ops): For Friday KPI deck, can we include: a slide comparing HubSpot vs SFDC counts, a breakdown by UTM_campaign, and a proposed action plan?
Diego R.: I'll create a small viz with dual-source lines and an annotation for 3/12 webhook gap.
Priya K.: I'll audit the form-to-CRM mapping and post results in the thread.
Ari (growth): Suggest A/B on pricing page messaging for the webinar nurture cohort. If there's a CRM undercount we'll still see relative lift on CTR/engagement.
Nora (mktg ops): Timeline?
Diego R.: Viz by EOD.
Priya K.: Mapping audit complete by tomorrow noon.
Ari (growth): AB test plan draft by end of day tomorrow.
ops-bot: "ops-bot: Weekly KPI sync Friday 10:00am — invite in #marketing"
Nora (mktg ops): Great. Also, add a small footnote in the deck about attribution window (7d vs 30d) since that shifts the MQL numbers.
Diego R.: Will do.
Priya K.: Noted.
Ari (growth): See you at the sync.
Nora (mktg ops): Thanks team.
